characters.summary: The Dovahkiin is a master of weapon combat, magic, and the ancient Voice of the Dragons (Shouts). They fight by combining shouts to manipulate the battlefield, casting destruction or conjuration magic, and wielding physical weapons or enchanted gear.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to prolonged status effects without resistance gear
Susceptible to being overwhelmed by large coordinated groups of high-tier enemies
limitations: Shouts require a cooldown period between uses
Magicka pool limits continuous spellcasting without enchanted gear

sources.supports: Abilities, Shouts, and general combat capabilities of the Dragonborn in Skyrim.

feats.claim: Defeated Alduin the World-Eater in Sovngarde
feats.citation: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim main questline

notableResults.citation: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim main questline finale
notableResults.note: Fought with the aid of ancient Hero-Nords in Sovngarde.

conditional.dependsOn: Must target dragons to force them to land

campaignTags.claim: Can cast various magic spells across destruction, restoration, illusion, and conjuration schools.
Uses powerful magical shouts and enchantments.

unknowns: Exact canonical race, gender, and weapon specialization are variable by player choice.

characters.summary: Dr. Eggman is a brilliant mad scientist who fights almost exclusively using advanced robotics, massive mechs, and flying vehicles. He relies on his intellect and engineering to deploy overwhelming mechanized armies.

mechanisms: Escaping via hidden thrusters or teleportation devices

weaknesses: Ego-driven tactics often leave openings for counterattacks
limitations: Relies entirely on external technology for combat power

sources.supports: Dr. Eggman's history, tech, mechs, and abilities across the Sonic series.

feats.claim: Split the planet Earth into multiple pieces using Chaos energy in Sonic Unleashed

notableResults.note: Usually defeated despite extensive preparation and machinery.

conditional.dependsOn: Must have time to construct or deploy them

campaignTags.claim: Builds advanced robotics, mechs, and technological superweapons.
Pilots the Egg Mobile and various heavy combat mechs.
Master roboticist and inventor of hundreds of robotic designs.

unknowns: Exact capabilities vary widely depending on which specific mech or game era is referenced.

characters.summary: Dr. Thomas Light is a pacifist scientific genius rather than a frontline combatant. In combat contexts, his contributions are purely indirect, involving the creation of advanced robotic assistants and upgrading other fighters.

techniques: Providing technological upgrades and support items

weaknesses: Lacks any physical combat ability or direct offensive capabilities
limitations: Completely non-combatant in personal physical confrontations

sources.supports: Dr. Light's background, role as a roboticist, and creator of Mega Man.

feats.claim: Created advanced sentient robotics such as Mega Man, Roll, and Proto Man

campaignTags.claim: Creates high-tech robotics and artificial intelligence.
Master robotics engineer responsible for Mega Man and Rush.

unknowns: Not typically depicted engaging in direct physical combat.

characters.summary: Dr. Neo Cortex is a mad scientist who fights using ray guns, hoverboards, mutant henchmen, and various technological inventions. He attacks at range with energy blasts and gadgets.
weaknesses: Prone to miscalculating his own inventions
limitations: Relies heavily on technological gadgets that can malfunction

sources.supports: Dr. Neo Cortex's weaponry, inventions, and boss encounters.

feats.claim: Engineered the Cortex Vortex to mind-control earth's animals

notableResults.note: Consistently defeated by Crash despite numerous sci-fi weapons.

campaignTags.claim: Uses laser ray guns and high-tech hoverboards.
Genetically engineered various mutant animals including Crash Bandicoot.

unknowns: Exact combat effectiveness fluctuates between games.

characters.summary: Dr. Albert Wily is a genius roboticist and antagonist who fights using complex battle machines, flying capsules, and armies of Robot Masters. He utilizes ranged energy weapons and heavy machinery.
weaknesses: Arrogance and cowardice when his machines are destroyed
limitations: Physically fragile without his combat capsules or machines

sources.supports: Dr. Wily's creations, Wily Machines, and boss battles.

feats.claim: Reprogrammed Dr. Light's industrial robots to conquer the world

notableResults.note: Defeated repeatedly despite staging battles inside fortified fortresses.

campaignTags.claim: Constructs advanced robotic war machines and the Wily Capsule.
Created numerous powerful Robot Masters and fortress bases.

unknowns: Varies in tactical complexity depending on which Wily Machine is deployed.

characters.summary: Duke Nukem is a tough-talking action hero who fights using conventional firearms, explosives, and sheer physical force. He specializes in heavy ranged firepower and brutal close-quarters combat.
weaknesses: Overconfidence and reliance on conventional weaponry against supernatural foes
limitations: Ammo capacity limits continuous heavy firing

sources.supports: Duke Nukem's characteristics, weapons, and game history.

feats.claim: Defeated the alien overlord Cycloid Emperor

notableResults.note: Defeated in direct combat using heavy explosives.

campaignTags.claim: Uses equipment like Holo-Duke and night vision goggles.

unknowns: Exact arsenal varies across different game entries.

characters.summary: Ellie is a resourceful survivor who relies on stealth, improvised crafting, firearms, and melee weapons. She fights using guerrilla tactics, taking cover and eliminating enemies silently or with precise shots.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to heavy physical trauma and firearms without cover

sources.supports: Ellie's skills, weapons, and survival background.

feats.claim: Survived years of infection and hostile human factions across the United States
feats.citation: The Last of Us Part I and Part II

notableResults.note: Ambushed and killed David with a meat cleaver in a burning restaurant.

campaignTags.claim: Extensively uses stealth to evade and ambush enemies.
Crafts and uses molotov cocktails to burn enemies.

unknowns: Combat capabilities scale with player progression and available scavenged gear.

characters.summary: Ezio Auditore is a Master Assassin who fights using hidden blades, swords, throwing knives, and environmental agility. He specializes in stealth assassinations, counter-attacks, and free-running mobility.
weaknesses: Vulnerable when swarmed by heavily armored guards in open combat
limitations: Human physical limits; relies heavily on surprise and finesse rather than brute force

sources.supports: Ezio Auditore's weapons, assassin training, and historical setting.

feats.claim: Overthrew the Templar influence throughout Italy and established the restored Brotherhood

notableResults.note: Defeated Borgia in a fistfight beneath the Vatican.

campaignTags.claim: Performs stealth assassinations and blends into crowds.
Uses smoke bombs, hidden blades, and poison darts.

unknowns: Arsenal expands significantly across his three game appearances.

characters.summary: Ezreal is a nimble magic-user who fights by firing rapid energy projectiles from his mystical gauntlet. He relies on long-range poke attacks and instant teleportation to evade danger.
weaknesses: Low durability if caught without his teleport escape
limitations: Relies entirely on the magic of his gauntlet for offense and mobility

sources.supports: Ezreal's abilities, Shuriman gauntlet, and combat style.

feats.claim: Explored dangerous ancient tombs and survived magical guardians using his gauntlet
feats.citation: League of Legends lore / Ezreal biography

campaignTags.claim: Channels raw magical energy through his ascended gauntlet.
Uses Arcane Shift to instantly teleport short distances.

unknowns: Actual combat performance varies based on in-game item builds.

characters.summary: Falco Lombardi is an expert pilot and sharpshooter who fights primarily from the cockpit of his Arwing starfighter or using blasters on foot. He combines aerial dogfighting agility with precise marksmanship.
weaknesses: Arrogant attitude can lead to taking unnecessary risks
limitations: Fighter craft is vulnerable if shields are depleted

sources.supports: Falco Lombardi's piloting skills, Arwing capabilities, and combat history.

feats.claim: Fought alongside Fox McCloud to defeat Andrew Oikonny and the Aparoid threat

conditional.dependsOn: Must be piloting the Arwing or similar spacecraft

campaignTags.claim: Expert pilot of the Arwing starfighter.
Uses advanced starfighter weaponry and smart bombs.

unknowns: Ground combat proficiency is secondary to his stellar piloting abilities.
